source.verification_scope: Table/ordered column sets, type/size, nullability, identity presence, simple defaults, PK/unique keys, FK mappings, CHECK counts, enabled/trusted constraints, explicit index names.

checks: (RoleCode='INDIA_ADMIN' AND ScopeType='INDIA') OR (RoleCode='LOCATION_ADMIN' AND ScopeType='LOCATION') OR (RoleCode='PROJECT_ADMIN' AND ScopeType IN ('PROJECT','PROJECT_LOCATION')) OR (RoleCode IN ('GUARD','RECEPTION') AND ScopeType='LOCATION')

(ScopeType='INDIA' AND LocationId IS NULL AND ProjectId IS NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NULL) OR (ScopeType='LOCATION' AND LocationId IS NOT NULL AND ProjectId IS NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NULL) OR (ScopeType='PROJECT' AND LocationId IS NULL AND ProjectId IS NOT NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NULL) OR (ScopeType='PROJECT_LOCATION' AND LocationId IS NULL AND ProjectId IS NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NOT NULL)
ValidUntilUtc IS NULL OR ValidUntilUtc > ValidFromUtc
(RevokedAtUtc IS NULL AND RevokedByUserId IS NULL) OR (RevokedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND RevokedByUserId IS NOT NULL AND RevokedAtUtc >= CreatedAtUtc)

checks: (RequestType='TEMP_ID' AND EmployeeId IS NOT NULL AND PersonEmail IS NOT NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NULL AND HostEmployeeId IS NULL AND TemporaryIdReason IN ('FORGOT','LOST','OTHER') AND TemporaryIdReason IS NOT NULL AND ApprovalDeadlineUtc IS NULL AND Status IN ('APPROVED','CANCELLED')) OR (RequestType='EMPLOYEE_PROJECT' AND EmployeeId IS NOT NULL AND PersonEmail IS NOT NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NOT NULL AND HostEmployeeId IS NOT NULL AND TemporaryIdReason IS NULL AND ApprovalDeadlineUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (RequestType='EXTERNAL' AND EmployeeId IS NULL AND ProjectLocationId IS NOT NULL AND HostEmployeeId IS NOT NULL AND TemporaryIdReason IS NULL AND ApprovalDeadlineUtc IS NOT NULL)
ApprovalDeadlineUtc IS NULL OR (ApprovalDeadlineUtc > SubmittedAtUtc AND ApprovalDeadlineUtc <= ValidUntilUtc)
((Status IN ('APPROVED','DENIED')) AND DecisionAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status='PENDING' AND DecisionAtUtc IS NULL) OR Status='CANCELLED'
(Status='CANCELLED' AND CancelledAtUtc IS NOT NULL) OR (Status<>'CANCELLED' AND CancelledAtUtc IS NULL)

indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_Outbox_Due ON gp.NotificationOutbox(Status, NextAttemptAtUtc) INCLUDE (AttemptCount, MaxAttempts, LockedUntilUtc);

tables.name: SecurityAuditEvents
tables.purpose: Append-only application audit; independent protected export required for tamper resistance.

columns.name: AuditEventId
columns.meaning: Immutable audit sequence.

columns.name: ActorUserId
columns.meaning: Authenticated actor, null for system/public actor.

columns.name: ActionCode
columns.meaning: Allowlisted security/business action.

columns.name: TargetType
columns.meaning: Target entity kind.

columns.name: TargetReference
columns.meaning: Non-secret internal target reference.

columns.name: LocationId
columns.meaning: Location scope when known.

columns.name: ProjectLocationId
columns.meaning: Project-office scope; requires matching LocationId.

columns.name: ResultCode
columns.meaning: SUCCESS, DENIED or ERROR.

columns.name: MetadataJson
columns.meaning: Allowlisted minimal audit metadata; no raw tokens/photo content.

columns.name: CorrelationId
columns.meaning: Operation trace identifier.

columns.name: OccurredAtUtc
columns.meaning: Server recording time.

checks: ProjectLocationId IS NULL OR LocationId IS NOT NULL
indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_Audit_Time ON gp.SecurityAuditEvents(OccurredAtUtc DESC);
CREATE INDEX IX_Audit_Scope ON gp.SecurityAuditEvents(LocationId, ProjectLocationId, OccurredAtUtc DESC);

tables.name: Sessions
tables.purpose: Revocable server-side staff sessions; browser holds only opaque secure-cookie ID.

columns.name: SessionHash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of random session credential.

columns.name: UserId
columns.meaning: Authenticated owner.

columns.name: CsrfHash
columns.meaning: Digest used to validate session-bound mutation protection.

columns.name: AuthorizationVersionAtIssue
columns.meaning: Reference version; current authorization is always re-evaluated.

columns.name: LastSeenAtUtc
columns.meaning: Most recent accepted activity.

columns.name: IdleExpiresAtUtc
columns.meaning: Server-enforced idle deadline.

columns.name: AbsoluteExpiresAtUtc
columns.meaning: Non-extendable session deadline.

columns.name: RevokedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Explicit logout/account/session invalidation.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Server creation timestamp in UTC.

checks: LastSeenAtUtc >= CreatedAtUtc AND IdleExpiresAtUtc > LastSeenAtUtc AND AbsoluteExpiresAtUtc >= IdleExpiresAtUtc
indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_Session_User ON gp.Sessions(UserId, RevokedAtUtc, AbsoluteExpiresAtUtc);

tables.name: GuardCredentials
tables.purpose: Individual local guard login identity and adaptive password hash, separate from employee SSO/directory.

columns.name: UserId
columns.meaning: One guard application user; credential provisioning grants no roles.

columns.name: LoginId
columns.meaning: Unique lowercase ASCII login ID; password normalization is never inferred from this.

columns.name: EncodedPasswordHash
columns.meaning: Salted Argon2id PHC string; NULL while awaiting controlled setup/reset. Auth service only.

columns.name: CredentialVersion
columns.meaning: Generation fencing for verification/reset; increment on credential mutation.

columns.name: IsEnabled
columns.meaning: Credential enabled independently of global user state; both must permit authentication.

columns.name: MustChangePassword
columns.meaning: Setup/reset required; no ordinary login until password setup completes.

columns.name: FailedCount
columns.meaning: Completed failed checks in the current window; five triggers temporary lockout.

columns.name: FailureWindowStartUtc
columns.meaning: Start of the provisional 15-minute failure window.

columns.name: LockedUntilUtc
columns.meaning: Temporary lockout; checked again at login completion.

columns.name: PasswordChangedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Last password setup/change time; NULL when the password is cleared for setup.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Credential record creation timestamp.

columns.name: RowVer
columns.meaning: Database concurrency version.

checks: DATALENGTH(LoginId) BETWEEN 3 AND 64 AND DATALENGTH(LoginId)=LEN(LoginId) AND LoginId NOT LIKE '%[^a-z0-9._-]%' AND LoginId NOT LIKE '[^a-z0-9]%'
(EncodedPasswordHash IS NULL AND MustChangePassword=1 AND PasswordChangedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (EncodedPasswordHash IS NOT NULL AND MustChangePassword=0 AND PasswordChangedAtUtc IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: GuardSetupTickets
tables.purpose: Single-use expiring setup/reset handles; raw handles remain outside SQL/logs.

columns.name: TokenHash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of the random 32-byte setup handle; not a password hash.

columns.name: UserId
columns.meaning: Target guard credential.

columns.name: CredentialVersion
columns.meaning: Credential generation to which this setup handle is bound.

columns.name: CreatedByUserId
columns.meaning: Scoped administrator that issued setup/reset.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Handle issue timestamp.

columns.name: ExpiresAtUtc
columns.meaning: Exclusive 15-minute expiry.

columns.name: UsedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Consumed or invalidated timestamp.

checks: ExpiresAtUtc>CreatedAtUtc AND (UsedAtUtc IS NULL OR UsedAtUtc>=CreatedAtUtc)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_GuardSetup_User ON gp.GuardSetupTickets(UserId,ExpiresAtUtc);

tables.name: GuardLoginAttempts
tables.purpose: Short-lived server-only password verification reservations, fenced to account and authorization generations.

columns.name: AttemptHash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of a random server-only verification handle.

columns.name: UserId
columns.meaning: Target guard identity.

columns.name: SourceHash
columns.meaning: Trusted server-derived keyed source bucket; never a browser-provided identity.

columns.name: CredentialVersion
columns.meaning: Password generation captured before expensive verification.

columns.name: AuthorizationVersion
columns.meaning: Authorization generation captured before expensive verification.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Verification reservation timestamp.

columns.name: ExpiresAtUtc
columns.meaning: Exclusive 60-second completion deadline.

columns.name: UsedAtUtc
columns.meaning: Single-use completion timestamp, including denied completion.

checks: ExpiresAtUtc>CreatedAtUtc AND (UsedAtUtc IS NULL OR UsedAtUtc>=CreatedAtUtc)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_GuardLogin_User ON gp.GuardLoginAttempts(UserId,ExpiresAtUtc) INCLUDE (UsedAtUtc);
CREATE INDEX IX_GuardLogin_Expiry ON gp.GuardLoginAttempts(ExpiresAtUtc);

tables.name: GuardAuthSources
tables.purpose: Short-lived source throttling buckets, including unknown account attempts; no raw network address or login identifier.

columns.name: SourceHash
columns.meaning: Trusted server-derived keyed source bucket digest.

columns.name: WindowStartUtc
columns.meaning: Current 60-second admission window.

columns.name: RequestCount
columns.meaning: Admitted attempts, bounded to twenty per window.

columns.name: LastSeenAtUtc
columns.meaning: Last admitted request; transient cleanup anchor.

indexes: CREATE INDEX IX_GuardAuthSources_Seen ON gp.GuardAuthSources(LastSeenAtUtc);

tables.name: RegistrationIntakeAccess
tables.purpose: Owned intake CSRF binding and immutable submission receipt; registration correlation only, no operational group state.

columns.name: IntakeId
columns.meaning: One intake capability/receipt record linked to RegistrationIntakes.

columns.name: CsrfHash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of a separate random intake CSRF value; both it and the intake token are required.

columns.name: SubmittedPayloadHash
columns.meaning: Versioned canonical business payload digest; immutable once the intake submits, independent of encryption retries.

columns.name: SubmissionResultJson
columns.meaning: Resource references and initial outcomes only; no QR/password/key/contact material. Supports retries after idempotency retention.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: UTC creation time of this intake binding.

checks: DATALENGTH(CsrfHash) = 32 AND (SubmittedPayloadHash IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(SubmittedPayloadHash) = 32)
(SubmittedPayloadHash IS NULL AND SubmissionResultJson IS NULL) OR (SubmittedPayloadHash IS NOT NULL AND SubmissionResultJson IS NOT NULL AND ISJSON(SubmissionResultJson)=1)

tables.name: PassPrintRenderState
tables.purpose: Restricted render fencing, source binding and artifact digest for one reception print job; no rendered card or plaintext credential storage.

columns.name: PrintJobId
columns.meaning: One-to-one link to the existing individual print job.

columns.name: ClaimToken
columns.meaning: Fresh internal renderer fencing token; never returned by the general API.

columns.name: LeaseUntilUtc
columns.meaning: UTC exclusive upper bound on the current claim and handoff; 60 seconds per attempt.

columns.name: AttemptCount
columns.meaning: Bounded render claims, at most three; retries of one live claim do not increment.

columns.name: SourceVisitStatus
columns.meaning: Pending/approved status bound to the claim so decisions during rendering invalidate stale content.

columns.name: SourceSnapshotHash
columns.meaning: Exact immutable visit snapshot digest bound to the render claim.

columns.name: SourcePhotoHash
columns.meaning: Exact photo content digest bound to the render claim.

columns.name: ArtifactDigest
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of renderer-produced SVG bytes; does not prove paper output.

columns.name: FailureCode
columns.meaning: Controlled redacted failure category; no provider text, credentials or private paths.

columns.name: CreatedAtUtc
columns.meaning: UTC creation time of this print-render state.

columns.name: SourceCardDataHash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 binding of trusted printable employee/host identity, purpose and current assigned-project summary. Rechecked at render completion and dispatch; not an authorization token.

checks: (ClaimToken IS NULL AND LeaseUntilUtc IS NULL) OR (ClaimToken IS NOT NULL AND LeaseUntilUtc IS NOT NULL)

(SourceVisitStatus IS NULL AND SourceSnapshotHash IS NULL AND SourcePhotoHash IS NULL) OR
        (SourceVisitStatus IS NOT NULL AND SourceVisitStatus IN('PENDING','APPROVED') AND SourceSnapshotHash IS NOT NULL AND DATALENGTH(SourceSnapshotHash)=32 AND SourcePhotoHash IS NOT NULL AND DATALENGTH(SourcePhotoHash)=32)
